thread:
mira: Heads up: onboarding sample-app produced duplicate webhook deliveries after a 429 + token refresh. quick repro: generate -> 429 -> sdk refresh -> immediate retry -> two webhook posts.
aj: can you paste the minimal log? curious whether sdk retried immediately.
mira: snippet: `OUT: POST /v1/generate id=req-7f` -> `RECV: 429` -> sdk: `auth.refresh()` -> `OUT: POST /v1/generate id=req-7f` -> `RECV: 200 gen_x` . webhook got gen_x and gen_y ~150ms apart.
jon: do we set Idempotency-Key for generation in sample-app?
mira: no, only for payments. we assumed safe-replay would avoid dupes.
aj: two options: (1) recommend sample-app set Idempotency-Key for any flow that posts to customers, (2) change sdk to add a small random delay after post-refresh retries, (3) optional short-lived client dedupe cache.
jon: prefer (1) as primary guidance. For SDK, add default post-refresh jitter 100+\u2212 75ms exposed as config `postAuthRetryJitterMs`. make transient dedupe opt-in behind `enableTransientDedupe`.
mira: streaming callers need immediate resume; ensure jitter is disabled for streaming paths.
aj: agreed. also emit a diagnostic event `retry_after_refresh` with request-hash so users can trace.
ci-bot: created ticket RDW-5123: "sdk: post-refresh retry jitter + diagnostics to reduce duplicate accepts"
mira: i'll open a tiny PR to sample-app to add Idempotency-Key for generate + a repro script, link RDW-5123. SRE can run quick validation.
jon: add a line in onboarding checklist: "set idempotency keys for requests that trigger external side-effects; do not rely solely on client heuristics".
aj: config defaults: `postAuthRetryJitterMsDefault=100`, `postAuthRetryJitterMsRange=75`, `enableTransientDedupe=false`.
mira: thx all, PR incoming :thumbsup:
